verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a processor (SoC). Bulk operations across many items is a software or application feature, so the story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships a bulk-operation capability. Performance claims such as running multiple Xcode simulators faster describe hardware speed, not a bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
